comment: The viewpoints the frame rate is judged at: unity/ArboristMod/perf.ts in GSPro, golfmap.perf.report in the Unity editor (which reads a copy in the course folder, Assets/GolfMap/<Course>/perf-views.json). Poses are world coordinates of the camera; rotation is euler pitch, yaw, roll; eye = metres over the ground instead of a fixed y. Target (Marcus, 2026-10-13): at least 90 fps mean and a 1 % low of at least 50 at each, 1920x1440 Medium, Unity and Arborist closed.
